blocks.text: Network security computer networks ki hifazat karti aur data ko be-ijazat rasai se mehfooz rakhti hai. Yeh data ke zaya aur nuqsan ko rokti, zaati aur ahem maloomat bachati, hackers ko andar aane se rokti, aur devices ko malware se bachati hai. Rozana bohat se users networks se jurte hain, is liye har network, ghar ho ya idara, ko bunyadi hifazati iqdamat chahiye.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Guftagu karein ke security hassas data, jaise hospital mein mareezon ke CT scans, ko kaise bachati hai.

blocks.caption: Network security ke tools
rows: Security device ya program jo aane jane wale traffic ko control karta hai. Yeh nuqsandeh ya na-pasandeeda data rokta aur mehfooz aur ghair-mehfooz networks ke darmiyan deewar ka kaam karta hai; gharon aur daftaron mein use hota hai.
Data ko khufia shakal mein badalti hai jise sirf ijazat yafta users parh sakte hain. Yeh muntaqili ke dauran data bachati, maslan email aur online banking mein, aur data chori rokti hai.

Tay karta hai ke network kaun use kare: sirf ijazat yafta users andar aa sakte hain. Usernames aur passwords aam access controls hain, aur permissions had muqarrar karti hain ke har user kya kar sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen Internet ka badal. Darmiyan surkh eenton ki deewar: firewall: andar bahar ke traffic ke qawaid. Sabz teer 'allowed traffic' deewar se guzar kar sabz 'private network' dabbe mein jata jis mein computer, laptop aur server. Surkh teer 'harmful traffic' deewar se takra kar wapas murta, 'blocked'.
blocks.caption: Internet aur private network ke darmiyan firewall (Fig 1.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Firewall har traffic ko apne qawaid se jaanchta hai: jis ki ijazat hai woh guzarta hai, aur jo nuqsandeh naqshe se milta hai woh private network tak pohanchne se pehle rok liya jata hai.

items: Viruses aur malware systems ko nuqsan pohanchate hain.
Hackers data churane ki koshish karte hain.
Phishing users ko dhoka de kar maloomat hasil karti hai.
Denial of Service (DoS) hamle services par traffic ki bharmar kar ke unhein rok dete hain.

blocks.text: Firewall, encryption aur access control jaise security tools in khatron ko kam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Har tool ko us ke kaam se milayein: firewall, encryption, access control.
blocks.explanation: Firewall: networks ke darmiyan traffic chhanta hai. Encryption: data ko key ke baghair na-qabil-e-parhai banati hai. Access control: tay karta hai ke network kaun use kare aur kya kare.

items: Network security data aur devices ko be-ijazat rasai aur malware se bachati.
Tools: firewall (traffic chhanta), encryption (khufia shakal), access control (kaun aaye).
Khatre: viruses aur malware, hackers, phishing, denial of service.
